# DEPLOY1R1 read-only final re-review

**Verdict: not APPROVED** — one **P2** smoke gap vs DEPLOY1R1 packet §6; prior DEPLOY1 **P1** and listed **P2** items appear closed in code. No new **P0** identified. Action SHAs are structurally pinned but not re-validated against upstream tags in this pass (no shell).

---

## Prior DEPLOY1 P1 / P2 closure matrix

| Original finding | Expected fix | Evidence | Status |
|------------------|--------------|----------|--------|
| **P1** Partial `dynamicParams` patch without restore | Track on first bak; `finally` + signal restore | `build-pages-lib.ts` 255–257 bak + `mutatedParamRels` before patch; 144–155 `restoreAll`; 340–358 `build()` `finally`; 319–337 signal handlers call `restoreAll` before `process.exit` | **Closed** |
| **P2** SIGINT/SIGTERM / SIGKILL ops | Handlers + docs | Handlers + header recovery docs (SIGKILL acknowledged) | **Closed** (residual SIGKILL = documented ops) |
| **P2** Stale parked proxy blocks run | Auto-recover proxy missing + parked; fail if both | `recoverStaleState` 161–175, 230–237 `isolateProxy` guard | **Closed** for `build:pages` entry |
| **P2** `GL_PAGES_EXPORT` without public base | Fail-fast + tests | `pages-export-env.ts`, `next.config.ts` 27–30, tests 39–79 | **Closed** |
| **P2** Floating Action majors | Full SHA + comments | `deploy-pages.yml` 33–84; `dependabot.yml` | **Closed** (authenticity see below) |
| **P2** CI missing normal gates | Sequential check + web + audit + smokes + pages | `deploy-pages.yml` 46–72 single job | **Closed** |
| **P2** Game `_next` false pass | Require `${PAGES_BASE}/_next/`; reject bare | `smoke-pages.mjs` 373–388 | **Closed** |
| **P2** gitignore park residue | Patterns added | `.gitignore` 6–7 | **Closed** |
| **P2** Interrupt stale parked (params) | Source+bak auto-recover | `recoverStaleState` 180–218 | **Closed** |

**Fault tests / byte restoration:** `deploy1r1-pages-hardening.test.ts` covers partial patch restore, success/fail `restoreAll`, stale proxy/params, ambiguous fail-closed, SIGTERM handler restore (`exitProcess: false`), export env negatives — aligned with worker report (not re-run here).

**No `shell: true`:** `build-pages-lib.ts` 295, `build-pages.mjs` 19; `smoke-pages.mjs` uses `http`/`fetch` only.

---

## Workflow validity

- Triggers, permissions (`contents: read`, `pages: write`, `id-token: write`), artifact path `platform/apps/web/out`, `github-pages` environment, deploy step id — consistent with Pages OIDC deploy.
- **Concurrency:** `cancel-in-progress: true` on group `pages-german-learning-exam` — overlapping jobs can SIGTERM mid-`build:pages`; signal path restores before exit (not relying on `finally` after `process.exit`). CI workspace is discarded; local risk is same as DEPLOY1 (documented).
- **Sequencing:** Normal gates before `build:pages` — no parallel wrapper mutation in workflow.

---

## Action SHA authenticity (read-only)

| Check | Result |
|-------|--------|
| Floating `@v4` / `@v5` refs in workflow | None |
| Format | Five `uses:` lines with 40-char SHAs + version comments |
| Match worker report table | Identical SHAs/tags |
| Independent `gh api` tag→commit verification | **Not performed** (no shell) |

**Open (non-blocking unless SHAs are wrong):** orchestrator spot-check via worker method; wrong SHA would fail or drift supply chain — not provable as defect from disk alone.

---

## Wrapper concurrency / destructive risks

| Risk | Assessment |
|------|------------|
| Parallel local `build:pages` | Second run hits parked/bak guards — fail closed |
| `build:web` then `build:pages` | Sequential in CI; different code paths — OK |
| Interrupted isolate → `dev` without `build:pages` | `recoverStaleState` only in `build()` — manual/`build:pages` still required; documented |
| Cancel-in-progress on CI | SIGTERM restore in handler; VM discarded |

No new **P0/P1** wrapper defect found beyond the smoke gap below.

---

## New / residual actionable items

| Severity | Location | Issue | Why actionable |
|----------|----------|--------|----------------|
| **P2** | `platform/apps/web/scripts/smoke-pages.mjs` **345–348** | `must200` HTTP loop only asserts `text.includes(PAGES_BASE) \|\| text.includes("_next")` — does **not** require `${PAGES_BASE}/_next/` and does **not** reject bare `src="/_next/` / `href="/_next/` for those routes (concepts, encoded activity, detail, conversation, etc.). Bare-root `_next` could pass HTTP smoke while failing only on a subset of static HTML scans + the duplicate game fetch. | DEPLOY1R1 packet §6: strengthen smoke to **require base-prefixed `_next` hydration references** and **reject bare root `_next`** — game block (373–388) and `verifyAssetRefs` (194–196) are partial; **must200** is the gap. |
| **P3** | `platform/apps/web/lib/content/ssg-dynamic-params.ts` | Tombstone `export {}` — packet asked physical delete; no imports | Hygiene / packet §2 completeness; not deploy/security **P0–P2** |

**Not raised as P2:** `verifyAssetRefs` 190–192 allows `"${PAGES_BASE}/"` without `_next/` (weaker than game/index asset checks); defense-in-depth only if export regresses.

---

## Summary

- **P0:** none identified.
- **P1:** prior item closed (transactional isolation + restore).
- **P2:** prior DEPLOY1 P2 list closed in implementation; **one new/residual P2** — incomplete HTTP `_next` strictness on `must200` routes.

**Do not APPROVE** until `must200` enforces base-prefixed `_next` (and bare-root rejection) consistently with game/asset checks, or the packet is explicitly narrowed to game + static sample only.

**APPROVE** only after that P2 is fixed and SHAs are spot-checked (or accepted on trust from worker evidence).
